analyzed_vuln.description: Double-free of alias flag arrays due to ownership confusion between alias table entries and dictionary entry flag pointers. parse_aliasf() stores decoded flag buffers in aliasf[]. Later, when dictionary words reference AF aliases, get_aliasf() returns the same aliasf pointer and add_word stores it in hentry::astr. In HashMgr::free_table(), free_flag() conditionally deletes hentry::astr when TESTAFF(... ONLYUPCASEFLAG ...) is true even when aliasf is non-empty; then HashMgr::~HashMgr() unconditionally deletes all aliasf[] entries again, causing double-free.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires an affix file that defines AF aliases (so aliasf is populated) and causes at least one dictionary entry to use an alias whose flag set satisfies TESTAFF(astr, ONLYUPCASEFLAG, alen), making free_flag() delete an alias-owned buffer during free_table(). On object destruction, aliasf[] is deleted again in ~HashMgr. In this PoV, malformed FLAG long/AF lines produce such an alias via decode_flags() in parse_aliasf(), then teardown path in affdicfuzzer triggers the double free.
